units.title: had better / would rather
units.shortDescription: Лучше бы / предпочёл бы — советы и предпочтения.
units.theoryHtml:
had better ('d better) — настоятельный совет, часто с угрозой последствий: You 'd better hurry, or you'll miss it. Отрицание: You'd better not be late. Это не «прошлое» — had здесь историческая форма, время настоящее.

would rather ('d rather) — предпочтение: I 'd rather stay home. Отрицание: I'd rather not say. С разными подлежащими: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone (Past после would rather!).

ФормаПример
'd better + инфинитив без toWe'd better leave now.
'd better not + инф.You'd better not touch it.
'd rather + инф. без toI'd rather walk.
'd rather + sb + PastI'd rather you didn't smoke.

⚠ Частые ошибки: You'd better to go → better go (без to). I'd better not to be late → not be late. I'd rather to stay → rather stay.

Мини-диалог:
— We 'd better book a table — it's Friday. — True. And I'd rather sit outside.
— I'd rather you didn't — it might rain. You'd better not risk it.

exercises.prompt: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.

options: I had better to call her.

exercises.explanation: would rather not + инфинитив без to.

exercises.prompt: I'd ___ ___ (лучше не) argue with him. (2-3 слова)
I'd rather ___ ___ (ты не приходил) tomorrow. (2-3 слова)
exercises.correctAnswer: you didn't come|you did not come

units.title: Статьевые глаголы: know, like, believe
units.shortDescription: Глаголы состояния, которые не любят Continuous.
units.theoryHtml:
Статьевые (state) глаголы описывают состояния, а не действия — поэтому почти не используются в Continuous:

ГруппаГлаголы
мыслиknow, believe, understand, remember, forget, mean, realise
чувстваlike, love, hate, prefer, want, need, wish
владениеhave, own, belong, possess
восприятиеsee, hear, smell, taste, seem, look (as), sound

I know the answer (не am knowing). This belongs to me.

Некоторые могут быть и действиями — тогда Continuous возможен с другим смыслом: I think you're right (мнение) vs I'm thinking about it (размышляю). She has a car (имеет) vs She's having lunch (ест). The soup tastes good (вкус) vs The chef is tasting the soup (пробует).

⚠ Частые ошибки: I'm loving it — рекламный слоган, в учебном английском I love it. I'm wanting → I want. I'm seeing what you mean → I see what you mean.

Мини-диалог:
— Do you understand the rules? — I think so. But I don't remember case 3.
— OK, look: I own the ball, you have the court, and everyone wants to play. Simple!

options: I am wanting a new phone.

exercises.prompt: I ___ the answer right now. (считаю, обдумываю)
I ___ (вижу) the problem — let's fix it.

units.title: -ing как подлежащее: Swimming is fun
units.shortDescription: Герундий в роли подлежащего и дополнения.
units.theoryHtml:
Герундий (-ing) может быть подлежащим: Swimming is fun. Smoking kills. Learning a language takes time. Глагол при нём — единственное число: Reading books is relaxing.

Герундий после предлогов (обязательно -ing): good at swimming, interested in learning, afraid of flying, before going to bed, instead of complaining.

И после некоторых глаголов: enjoy, avoid, mind, suggest, finish, keep, practise, can't help, can't stand, it's worth: It's worth trying.

⚠ Частые ошибки: Swim is fun → Swimming is fun. Before to go → before going. I look forward to see you → look forward to seeing you (to здесь предлог!).

Мини-диалог:
— What do you do to relax? — Reading and swimming. Jogging is not my thing — I can't stand running in the cold.
— I'm looking forward to starting yoga. — It's worth trying!

exercises.prompt: ___ books is better than watching TV.
Instead of ___ about it, do something!
